initial:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original football videogame character art direction and consistent modeling reference sheet for Doppel 6.
Create a completely new, high-quality, coherent concept sheet, wide landscape format. A SINGLE consistent adult male professional football athlete, age 23–27, in four views: a large charismatic full-body three-quarter ball-control action pose on the left half, and three equal-size full-body neutral orthographic modeling views FRONT, SIDE, BACK on the right half. Same face, same haircut, same body and same uniform in every view; all feet visible, aligned ground line for turnaround views. Include a small clean three-quarter face study near upper right if space allows. Minimal editorial presentation on warm off-white background, very subtle ground shadow; no stadium, interface, decorative diagrams or marketing badges.

ART DIRECTION: premium modern stylized 3D football game art inspired by the energetic sports character readability of late-1990s International Superstar Soccer, translated into intentional contemporary game art. Original fictional player. Sophisticated sculpted planar forms and controlled bevels, a small number of meaningful broad facial and muscular planes, NOT random tiny triangles, NOT photorealism, NOT plastic toy, NOT cartoon child. Every form should be feasible to model in Blender. High visual craft and strong graphic readability.

ATHLETIC DESIGN: lean powerful adult football physique with roughly 7.5–8 head proportions, long functional legs, athletic quadriceps and defined calves, compact tapered waist, defined moderate deltoids and lean forearms. Shoulder-to-waist width ratio around 1.4, compact natural neck, ordinary adult head and hands. Muscles from real athletic anatomy, no superhero bodybuilding bulk, no giant thighs, no emaciation, no drooping rounded shoulders, no hunched elderly posture. Youthful angular handsome face with squared but slim jaw, firm cheek planes, calm focused eyes and neutral closed mouth; no sunken cheeks, exaggerated pursed lips, wrinkles, huge eyes or baby-face roundness. Short dark chestnut haircut: close sides and a simple sculpted swept-up top, modern sports haircut, no comb-over and no grey highlights.

UNIFORM: forest-green fitted short-sleeve football jersey, two broad horizontal ivory chest bands continuing around the back, clean narrow ivory sleeve trim, an intentionally modeled restrained ivory retro polo collar that lies flat on the garment, modest V opening. Navy tailored football shorts ending at mid-thigh, subtle restrained ivory number 6 on one shorts leg. Ivory knee-high fitted football socks with two thin forest-green bands at the top, low-profile black football cleats with clear boot silhouette, very restrained ivory laces, properly sized sole studs. No real team crest, sponsor, brand logo or extra text on clothes. Clean cloth panel shapes, enough ease for movement, a few intentional tension folds, no copied anatomical chest ridges or shredded edges.

POSE: Left hero pose must show unmistakable football athleticism, energetic and balanced: weight on a bent support leg, other foot poised near a correctly sized ivory/black ball, pelvis shifts over support foot, torso counter-rotates, shoulders and arms active for balance, fingers naturally loosely curled, head up and gaze across the field. Both feet grounded or plausibly mid-action, correct joints, no impossible anatomy. Right reference views have relaxed neutral A pose with arms about 20 degrees away from torso, palms naturally inward; no ball obscuring modeling views. Controlled directional daylight with rich matte green, ivory, navy, warm skin and dark brown hair. Show actual strong silhouettes rather than hiding behind cinematography.

TEXT: only small refined headings "DOPPEL 6 — ATHLET", "FRONT", "SEITE", "RÜCKEN". No technical claims or invented statistics.

Priority: adult youthful athlete, dynamic readable body design, geometrically clean collar, consistent anatomy across reference views, premium purposeful stylized modeling. Completely new design, do not emulate the rejected stock superhero-derived character.
stylized_revision:
Use case: style-transfer
Edit target: the supplied new Doppel 6 athlete concept sheet. Preserve its overall layout, the same youthful adult athlete, football-specific lean and powerful anatomy, all four full-body views, face inset, forest-green/ivory two-hoop polo jersey, navy shorts with ivory 6, ivory/green socks, black studded football boots, ball, poses and the small exact headings.
Change only the visual design language decisively: convert the entire athlete and clothes to PREMIUM STYLIZED 3D GAME CHARACTER CONCEPT ART, with unmistakable deliberate large planar surfaces, much simpler clean geometric shapes and matte untextured color blocks. Think elegant sculpted low-poly adult sports characters with controlled bevels and strong ISS-era football readability, updated for a modern browser game. This is a geometrically designed 3D character, not a photographic athlete or a realistic painting. Face should be built from broad, clear planes at forehead, brow, cheeks, slim squared jaw and nose; still adult age 24, focused and handsome, no huge eyes, no child head, no elderly face. Arms and muscular legs use about 5–8 meaningful planes around each cross-section, not smooth photographic muscle shading and not a noisy triangulation effect. Simplify hair to 5–7 dark chestnut sculpted solid clumps with clean short sides; no individual strands. Preserve the fitted tailored polo collar as a simple solid garment shape that lies naturally on the shirt. Reduce fabric to a few clean broad tension folds and smooth matte color, clear ivory hoop edges and simple tidy sleeve openings. Skin must have absolutely no photographic pores, veins, wrinkles, facial hair or skin texture; socks and shirt have no woven fabric texture; shoes have no tiny embossed details. Gentle consistent studio lighting reveals true angular geometry instead of painting tiny realism into the surfaces. The action pose retains visible muscular tension and adult athletic proportions. Keep orthographic references consistent, readable and on one ground line, with every foot visible. Keep the off-white editorial background clean. No new objects, badges, labels, anatomy annotations, numbers or claims.
Important: this must be a visibly strong stylistic transformation with large readable planar forms, not the same realistic artwork with a slight filter. Preserve the athlete's anatomy and confidence while simplifying the geometry.
